title: The impact of urban greening policies: Evidence from China’s National Garden City Program
title_zh: 城市绿化政策的影响：来自中国国家园林城市项目的证据
title_primary: 城市绿化政策的影响：来自中国国家园林城市项目的证据
title_secondary: The impact of urban greening policies: Evidence from China’s National Garden City Program
authors: Shengchen Yin, Xinyuan Zhang, Zhifang Wang
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-09-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Urban greening has become a widely adopted policy strategy for improving environmental quality and urban livability. However, the effectiveness of large-scale government-led greening programs and their ecological outcomes remain insufficiently evaluated, particularly in rapidly urbanizing countries. China’s National Garden City Program (NGCP), implemented nationwide for more than three decades, represents one of the world’s most extensive urban greening policy initiatives. Yet its actual impacts and underlying mechanisms across different regions and city types remain unclear. Using panel data from 293 prefecture-level cities between 2000 and 2022, this study applies a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) model to estimate the causal effects of the NGCP on urban greening. Results show that the NGCP significantly increases urban green coverage rates, but does not produce significant improvements in NDVI. Policy impacts vary spatially, with significant improvements in northern and southern cities and sub-provincial cities, while remaining insignificant in northwestern and Qinghai–Tibet regions. Mediation analysis indicates that industrial structure adjustment contributes to improvements in built-up-area NDVI, whereas fiscal investment is not a significant pathway. These findings demonstrate that government-led greening policies can effectively expand urban greenspace quantity but may not necessarily improve greenspace quality. The study highlights the importance of multidimensional evaluation frameworks and context-sensitive governance strategies for enhancing the ecological effectiveness of urban greening programs. The findings also provide evidence to support policymakers in refining the implementation and evaluation of urban greening policies, thereby improving the ecological effectiveness of future greening initiatives.
abstract_zh: 城市绿化已成为改善环境质量和提升城市宜居性的广泛采纳的政策策略。然而，大规模政府主导的绿化项目及其生态成效尚未得到充分评估，尤其是在快速城市化国家。中国国家园林城市项目（NGCP）在全国范围内实施已超过三十年，是全球最广泛的城市绿化政策举措之一，但其在不同地区和城市类型的实际影响及内在机制仍不明确。本研究利用2000年至2022年间293个地级市的面板数据，采用交错双重差分（DID）模型估计NGCP对城市绿化的因果效应。结果显示，NGCP显著提高了城市绿化覆盖率，但并未显著改善NDVI。政策影响存在空间异质性，北方和南方城市以及副省级城市有显著改善，而西北地区和青藏高原地区则不显著。中介分析表明，产业结构调整有助于提升建成区NDVI，而财政投入并非显著路径。这些发现表明，政府主导的绿化政策能有效扩大城市绿地数量，但未必能提升绿地质量。研究强调了多维评估框架和情境敏感治理策略对提升城市绿化项目生态有效性的重要性。研究结果也为政策制定者优化城市绿化政策的实施与评估提供了证据支持，从而提升未来绿化举措的生态成效。

title: Tax loss carryforwards and firms’ risk
title_zh: 税收亏损结转与企业风险
title_primary: 税收亏损结转与企业风险
title_secondary: Tax loss carryforwards and firms’ risk
authors: Jack Favilukis, Ron Giammarino, Jose Pizarro, Mikhail Simutin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Tax loss carryforwards (TLCF) — accumulated losses that reduce taxable income — are an important and risky corporate asset. We show theoretically how TLCF affect equity risk: If TLCF are low and used with certainty, equity risk decreases in TLCF because TLCF represent a safe cash flow; if TLCF are high, equity risk increases in TLCF because TLCF increase after-tax cash flows in good times but may expire unused or be deferred in bad times. In a calibrated model the latter effect dominates and risk increases in TLCF on average. Empirically, TLCF positively forecast firms’ volatility, beta, and return.
abstract_zh: 税收亏损结转（TLCF）——即减少应税收入的累计亏损——是一项重要且具有风险的企业资产。我们从理论上展示了TLCF如何影响股权风险：若TLCF较低且确定会被使用，则因其代表安全的现金流，股权风险随TLCF增加而降低；若TLCF较高，则因TLCF在景气时期增加税后现金流，但在不景气时期可能未使用而到期或递延，股权风险随TLCF增加而上升。在标定模型中，后一种效应占主导，平均而言风险随TLCF增加而上升。实证上，TLCF正向预测企业的波动率、贝塔系数及回报率。

title: Survival Analysis with Limited Overlap and Censoring Distribution Shift
title_zh: 有限重叠与删失分布偏移下的生存分析
title_primary: 有限重叠与删失分布偏移下的生存分析
title_secondary: Survival Analysis with Limited Overlap and Censoring Distribution Shift
authors: Meera Krishnamoorthy, Donna Tjandra, Divya Shanmugam, Amanda E. Kowalski, Jenna Wiens
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Survival analysis methods are often used to predict the time until the onset of an event in settings when the true time-to-event (TTE) may be censored during training. Such approaches typically assume uncensored data are representative of censored data and that the probability of censoring conditioned on the covariates remains constant over time, i.e., there is no censoring distribution shift. However, both assumptions can fail in practice when censoring results from interventions targeted to individuals with particular comorbidities or genetic markers (such as prophylactic surgery when predicting time to cancer onset, or scheduled cesarean delivery and induction when predicting time to spontaneous labor) and changes in clinical policies alter which individuals are targeted for these interventions over time. To address this, we propose a new approach, cluster-weighted inference of time-to event (CWITE), that remains accurate when these assumptions do not hold. Unlike existing approaches that ignore times-to-censoring (TTC) or treat them only as a lower bound of the TTE, CWITE leverages the insight that a subset of censored individuals are likely censored close to their true TTEs, and uses a novel mechanism to learn from such individuals. On the task of predicting time to spontaneous labor using real-world data, CWITE improves TTE accuracy for individuals similar to censored training data (mean absolute error: 6.50 days, 95% CI: [5.55, 7.40] vs. 7.82 days, [6.82, 8.82]) while maintaining comparable performance for those similar to uncensored training data (6.50 days, [5.54, 7.61] vs. 6.63 days, [5.67,7.69]). Our results demonstrate that incorporating more specific supervision from censored training data can significantly improve TTE predictions in settings with limited overlap and censoring distribution shift, challenges common in real-world clinical data. Code to implement CWITE and reproduce all experiments in the paper is available at https://github.com/MLD3/CWITE.
abstract_zh: 生存分析方法常用于预测事件发生前的时间，在训练过程中真实事件发生时间（TTE）可能被审查的情况下。这类方法通常假设未审查数据能代表审查数据，并且给定协变量时审查概率随时间保持不变，即不存在审查分布偏移。然而，在实践中，当审查源于针对具有特定合并症或遗传标记个体的干预措施（如预测癌症发病时间时的预防性手术，或预测自然分娩时间时的计划剖宫产和引产）以及临床政策随时间变化导致针对这些干预措施的个体目标改变时，这两个假设都可能失效。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新方法，即聚类加权事件时间推断（CWITE），该方法在这些假设不成立时仍能保持准确性。与现有方法忽略审查时间（TTC）或仅将其视为TTE的下界不同，CWITE利用了一个洞察：一部分被审查的个体可能在其真实TTE附近被审查，并通过一种新颖机制从这些个体中学习。在利用真实世界数据预测自然分娩时间的任务中，CWITE提高了与审查训练数据相似个体的TTE预测准确性（平均绝对误差：6.50天，95%置信区间：[5.55, 7.40]对比7.82天，[6.82, 8.82]），同时在与未审查训练数据相似个体上保持了相当的性能（6.50天，[5.54, 7.61]对比6.63天，[5.67, 7.69]）。我们的结果表明，在重叠有限和审查分布偏移的情况下，从审查训练数据中融入更具体的监督信息能显著改善TTE预测，这些挑战在真实临床数据中常见。实现CWITE并复现论文中所有实验的代码可在https://github.com/MLD3/CWITE获取。

title: Coal Supply Chains and Electricity Reliability
title_zh: 煤炭供应链与电力可靠性
title_primary: 煤炭供应链与电力可靠性
title_secondary: Coal Supply Chains and Electricity Reliability
authors: Imelda ., Suchita Srinivasan
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Can localized weather shocks to upstream fuel suppliers undermine down-stream electricity reliability? Using administrative data linking South African power plants to contracted coal mines from 2015 to 2024, we combine plant operating records, mining-firm revenue data, and route-level traffic sensor data. Exploiting within-plant variation in supplier-mine rainfall, we find that rainfall shocks reduce mine output and lower coal plant availability. Daily traffic data confirm that rainfall reduces coal deliveries along contracted mine-to-plant routes. These disruptions propagate to the grid, contributing to rolling blackouts. Electricity security hinges on the resilience of coal supplyn contracts and logistics, not only on plant resilience.
abstract_zh: 局部天气冲击是否会通过上游燃料供应商传导至下游电力可靠性？利用2015至2024年间连接南非电厂与签约煤矿的行政数据，我们整合了电厂运行记录、矿业公司收入数据及路线级交通传感器数据。通过利用电厂内部供应商煤矿降雨量的变异，我们发现降雨冲击降低了煤矿产出，并减少了燃煤电厂的可用性。每日交通数据证实，降雨减少了签约煤矿至电厂路线的煤炭交付量。这些中断向电网传播，加剧了轮流停电现象。电力安全不仅取决于电厂自身的韧性，还依赖于煤炭供应合同及物流的恢复能力。

title: Quality-driven price dispersion: Implications for testing market efficiency
title_zh: 质量驱动的价格离散：对市场效率检验的启示
title_primary: 质量驱动的价格离散：对市场效率检验的启示
title_secondary: Quality-driven price dispersion: Implications for testing market efficiency
authors: Hisaki Kono, David Ernst, Tsilavo Ralandison, Yutaka Arimoto
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Spatial price differences in agricultural markets, after accounting for transport costs, are often interpreted as evidence of market inefficiency. However, price differences may also reflect product quality variation, especially where formal grading systems are absent. This study uses a novel transaction-level dataset on paddy rice sales from rural Madagascar in 2022–2023, including laboratory-assessed grain quality indicators. By employing hedonic regressions, we construct a composite quality index to quantify the extent to which observed price variation across locations can be explained by quality differences. We find that varietal identity commands substantial price premiums, but measured physical and post-harvest quality attributes beyond variety explain only a small share of the observed price dispersion. Controlling for the quality attributes has little effect on conventional measures of market integration. This result suggests that buyers face difficulties in accurately assessing physical quality at the point of sale. In such contexts, buyers may rely on location-specific reputation as a substitute. Consistent with this, transactions originating from villages with higher average quality are associated with higher prices even after controlling for observable quality attributes. We interpret this as descriptive evidence consistent with reputation or relationship-based sourcing in settings with limited quality observability.
abstract_zh: 农业市场中的空间价格差异，在考虑运输成本后，常被视为市场效率低下的证据。然而，价格差异也可能反映产品质量的差异，尤其是在缺乏正式分级体系的地区。本研究利用2022至2023年间马达加斯加农村稻谷销售的独特交易层面数据集，其中包含实验室评估的谷物质量指标。通过运用特征回归模型，我们构建了一个综合质量指数，用以量化不同地点间观察到的价格差异在多大程度上可由质量差异解释。研究发现，品种身份能带来显著的价格溢价，但除品种外，测得的物理及收获后处理质量属性仅能解释观察到的价格离散度的一小部分。控制质量属性对传统的市场一体化衡量指标影响甚微。这一结果表明，买方在销售点难以准确评估物理质量。在此类情境下，买方可能依赖特定地点的声誉作为替代。与此一致的是，即便在控制可观测质量属性后，来自平均质量较高村庄的交易仍与较高价格相关联。我们将此解读为，在质量可观测性有限的环境中，与声誉或基于关系的采购模式相符的描述性证据。

title: The development studies divide: fierce fault lines or fruitful frictions?
title_zh: 发展研究的分歧：激烈的断层线还是富有成效的摩擦？
title_primary: 发展研究的分歧：激烈的断层线还是富有成效的摩擦？
title_secondary: The development studies divide: fierce fault lines or fruitful frictions?
authors: Arnim Scheidel
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The concept of development has deeply divided the social sciences concerned with peoples and earth’s future. For many researchers and practitioners, variants of development are crucial normative cornerstones to frame and guide research and policy. Many critical scholars and activists associate the term with colonial, capitalist, extractivist, and patriarchal threats, and see it as the root cause of environmental degradation. In short, some study development as a solution, others as the problem. I call this rift the Development Studies Divide. After tracing diverse disciplinary roots, I discuss where the fault lines run and whether fruitful frictions could enrich the future of (critical) development studies. Despite stark differences in ideological, epistemological, and conceptual orientations, there is room for mutual learning, specifically across methodologies. A reflexive integration of critical perspectives with quantitative methods can substantiate critical claims beyond isolated case studies, address them at larger scales, and generate robust knowledge on alternatives to development beyond largely theory-driven proposals. It could also correct global empirical analyses that become problematic when their assumptions and interpretations are not grounded in the diverse histories, worldviews, and values of non-Western realities.
abstract_zh: 发展这一概念在关注人类与地球未来的社会科学领域引发了深刻分歧。对于众多研究者与实践者而言，发展的各种变体是构建和指导研究与政策的关键规范性基石。而许多批判性学者和活动家则将这一术语与殖民、资本主义、榨取主义和父权制的威胁相联系，视其为环境退化的根本原因。简言之，有人将发展视为解决方案，有人则视之为问题所在。我将这一裂痕称为“发展研究鸿沟”。在追溯其多元学科根源后，我探讨了断层线的分布位置，以及富有成效的摩擦是否能丰富（批判性）发展研究的未来。尽管在意识形态、认识论和概念取向上存在显著差异，但仍有相互学习的空间，尤其是在方法论层面。将批判视角与定量方法进行反思性整合，能够超越孤立的案例研究，在更大尺度上证实批判性主张，并为超越发展之外的替代方案生成超越纯理论驱动的稳健知识。同时，这也能纠正全球实证分析中的问题——当这些分析的假设和解释未植根于非西方现实的多元历史、世界观和价值观时，它们便会变得问题重重。

title: Double Robustness of Local Projections and Some Unpleasant VARithmetic
title_zh: 局部投影的双重稳健性与一些令人不快的VAR算术
title_primary: 局部投影的双重稳健性与一些令人不快的VAR算术
title_secondary: Double Robustness of Local Projections and Some Unpleasant VARithmetic
authors: José Luis Montiel Olea, Mikkel Plagborg-Møller, Eric Qian, Christian K. Wolf
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We consider impulse response inference in a locally misspecified vector autoregression (VAR) model. The conventional local projection (LP) confidence interval has correct coverage even when the misspecification is so large that it can be detected with probability approaching 1. This result follows from a “double robustness” property analogous to that of popular partially linear regression estimators. By contrast, the conventional VAR confidence interval with short‐to‐moderate lag length can severely undercover for misspecification that is small, difficult to detect statistically, and cannot be ruled out based on economic theory. The VAR confidence interval has robust coverage if, and only if, the lag length is so large that the interval is as wide as the LP interval.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在局部误设定的向量自回归（VAR）模型中脉冲响应推断的问题。传统的局部投影（LP）置信区间即使在误设定程度大到能以趋近于1的概率被检测到时，仍能保持正确的覆盖率。这一结果源于一种与流行的部分线性回归估计量相似的“双重稳健性”性质。相比之下，采用短至中等滞后长度的传统VAR置信区间，在面对较小、难以从统计上检测且无法基于经济理论排除的误设定时，可能严重低估覆盖率。VAR置信区间只有在滞后长度足够大，使其区间宽度与LP区间相当时，才具有稳健的覆盖率。

title: Revisiting Pigouvian Taxes Under Credit Constraints and State Capacity Limitations
title_zh: 信贷约束与国家能力限制下的庇古税再探讨
title_primary: 信贷约束与国家能力限制下的庇古税再探讨
title_secondary: Revisiting Pigouvian Taxes Under Credit Constraints and State Capacity Limitations
authors: Jahan-Dideh, Mahsa
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper analyzes the taxation of emissions in the presence of two institutional frictions common in developing countries. First, credit markets are underdeveloped in terms of both access to credit and borrowing conditions. Second, limited state capacity restricts the operation of the tax system. The analysis shows that the second-best emissions tax reflects both marginal environmental damages, as in the Pigouvian principle, and the effectiveness of taxation in reducing pollution. Credit market frictions hinder the adoption of clean technologies and increase emissions, which would, in isolation, call for a higher Pigouvian tax. However, these frictions may also reduce the responsiveness of emissions to taxation by limiting firms’ ability to adopt cleaner technologies, thereby lowering the optimal second-best tax. To capture these mechanisms, the paper distinguishes between two types of distortions: collateral-based, productivity-independent differences in access to credit, and cash-flow–based borrowing constraints. The optimal tax responds differently to each type of distortion.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了发展中国家普遍存在的两种制度性摩擦对排放征税的影响。其一，信贷市场在信贷获取渠道与借贷条件方面均存在欠发达特征；其二，有限的国家能力制约了税收体系的运行效能。研究表明，次优排放税既需遵循庇古原则反映边际环境损害，又需体现税收在减少污染方面的有效性。信贷市场摩擦会阻碍清洁技术采用并增加排放量，单就这一效应而言，本应要求更高的庇古税。然而，这些摩擦通过限制企业采用清洁技术的能力，可能同时削弱排放对税收的响应弹性，从而降低最优次优税率。为捕捉上述机制，本文区分了两种不同类型的扭曲：基于抵押品且与生产率无关的信贷获取差异，以及基于现金流约束的借贷限制。最优税率对这两种扭曲的响应方式存在显著差异。

title: Immigration and Macroeconomic Outcomes in OECD Countries
title_zh: OECD国家移民与宏观经济结果
title_primary: OECD国家移民与宏观经济结果
title_secondary: Immigration and Macroeconomic Outcomes in OECD Countries
authors: Gaetano Basso, Mitali R. Mathur, Giovanni Peri
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: OECD countries experienced declining native population growth and rising net immigration over 1990-2024. We compile a new dataset of net immigration rates to OECD countries from all origins and show that most of the increase came from non-OECD countries and was predominantly high-skilled. Push factors, network effects, and policy indices explain little of the large cross-country heterogeneity in immigration dynamics; unexpected shocks and surges were common. Using local projections and several sources of identifying variation, we then estimate the relationship between immigration and growth in GDP per capita, labor productivity, capital investment, and total factor productivity (TFP). Immigration from non-OECD countries was a significant predictor of GDP per worker growth, primarily through higher investment. High-skilled immigration, in particular, was associated with stronger human capital accumulation, faster TFP growth, and greater capital deepening. Native population growth, by contrast, had no or weakly negative effects on GDP per capita and productivity. These results are consistent with a large literature documenting the positive productivity and growth effects of immigration, especially high-skilled immigration.
abstract_zh: 1990-2024年间，OECD国家经历了本土人口增长放缓与净移民持续上升的双重趋势。我们构建了涵盖所有来源国对OECD国家净移民率的新数据集，发现移民增长主要来自非OECD国家，且以高技能移民为主。推力因素、网络效应和政策指数难以解释各国移民动态的巨大异质性，突发性冲击与激增现象普遍存在。通过局部投影法结合多种识别变异来源，我们估算了移民与人均GDP、劳动生产率、资本投资及全要素生产率（TFP）增长之间的关系。非OECD国家移民对人均GDP增长具有显著预测作用，主要通过促进投资实现。高技能移民尤其与更强的人力资本积累、更快的TFP增长及更深的资本深化相关联。相比之下，本土人口增长对人均GDP和生产率无显著影响甚至呈现微弱负效应。这些结论与大量文献中关于移民（特别是高技能移民）对生产率和经济增长具有积极效应的研究结果一致。

title: Difference-in-differences with interference
title_zh: 存在干扰的双重差分法
title_primary: 存在干扰的双重差分法
title_secondary: Difference-in-differences with interference
authors: Ruonan Xu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In many scenarios, such as the evaluation of place-based policies, potential outcomes are not only dependent upon the unit's own treatment but also its neighbors' treatment. Despite this,"difference-in-differences"(DID) type estimators typically ignore such interference among neighbors. I show in this paper that the canonical DID estimators generally fail to identify interesting causal effects in the presence of neighborhood interference. To incorporate interference structure into DID estimation, I propose doubly robust estimators for the direct average treatment effect on the treated as well as the average spillover effects under a modified parallel trends assumption. I later relax common restrictions in the literature, such as immediate neighborhood interference and correctly specified spillover functions. Moreover, robust inference is discussed based on the asymptotic distribution of the proposed estimators.
abstract_zh: 在许多场景中，例如基于地点的政策评估，潜在结果不仅取决于个体自身的处理状态，还取决于其邻居的处理状态。然而，典型的“双重差分”（DID）类估计量通常忽略了这种邻居间的相互干扰。本文表明，在存在邻居干扰的情况下，经典DID估计量通常无法识别有意义的因果效应。为了将干扰结构纳入DID估计，本文在修正的平行趋势假设下，提出了针对处理组的直接平均处理效应以及平均溢出效应的双重稳健估计量。随后，本文放宽了文献中的常见限制条件，例如直接邻居干扰和正确设定的溢出函数。此外，基于所提估计量的渐近分布，本文讨论了稳健推断方法。

abstract: This article examines self-fulfilling prophecies and the conditions under which they are most likely to arise. The term ‘self-fulfilling prophecy’ (SFP) was coined in 1948 by Robert K. Merton to describe ‘a false definition of the situation evoking a new behavior which makes the originally false conception come true’. SFP is a particular type of dynamic process and is also known as ‘Oedipus effect’, ‘bootstrapped induction’ and ‘Barnesian performativity’. It has been discerned in a variety of processes; for example, between social theory and social reality. This article begins by proposing an explicit definition of SFP, followed by the argument that analytical sociology must be both empirical and theoretical. A summary of methods for investigating SFP is followed by a review of systematic empirical evidence for selected phenomena. Finally, explanations are given for why self-fulfilling prophecies occur: why false or arbitrary beliefs are formed and why they are subsequently fulfilled.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨自我实现预言及其最易产生的条件。“自我实现预言”（SFP）一词由罗伯特·K·默顿于1948年提出，用以描述“对情境的错误定义引发新行为，使原本虚假的观念变为现实”。SFP是一种特殊的动态过程，也被称为“俄狄浦斯效应”“自举归纳”和“巴恩斯式述行性”。它在多种过程中均有体现，例如社会理论与社会现实之间的互动。本文首先提出SFP的明确定义，继而论证分析社会学必须兼具经验性与理论性。在总结研究SFP的方法后，本文回顾了针对特定现象的系统性经验证据。最后，阐释自我实现预言为何发生：虚假或任意信念如何形成，以及这些信念为何最终得以实现。

title: The Long-Run Impacts of Protected Areas on Income, Birds, and Tourism in South Africa
title_zh: 保护区对南非收入、鸟类及旅游业的长期影响
title_primary: 保护区对南非收入、鸟类及旅游业的长期影响
title_secondary: The Long-Run Impacts of Protected Areas on Income, Birds, and Tourism in South Africa
authors: Engis, Dennis, Englander, Gabriel, Lee, Alan, Noack, Frederik
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Protected areas cover 17% of the world’s land surface, yet credible evidence on their long-run economic and ecological impacts remains scarce. This paper estimates the effects of South Africa’s protected areas on household income, bird biodiversity, and tourism consumer surplus. For the income and biodiversity analyses, it develops a machine-learning counterfactual approach that recovers the present-day impacts of protected areas created up to 100 years ago. Short-run impacts of newer protected areas are small and statistically insignificant, while older protected areas generate large gains. Prior research may have severely underestimated the benefits of protected areas by only estimating the short-run effects of newly established protected areas. In aggregate, this paper estimates that protected areas increase annual household income by approximately R300 billion (roughly 10% of 2011 GDP). This yields approximately 7.6 million job-equivalents attributable to South Africa’s protected areas. Different types of protected areas play complementary roles in conserving different categories of threatened birds, demonstrating the value of South Africa’s entire protected area network. A structural travel cost model estimates that South Africa’s national parks generate R7.7 billion per year (2023 rand) in recreational value for domestic and international tourists. These results suggest that in South Africa there is little tradeoff between wildlife conservation and economic development. Realizing the economic and ecological benefits of protected areas, however, requires patience: returns to conservation accumulate over decades, not years.
abstract_zh: 保护区覆盖了全球17%的陆地面积，但关于其长期经济与生态影响的可信证据仍然匮乏。本文估算了南非保护区对家庭收入、鸟类生物多样性及旅游消费者剩余的影响。在收入与生物多样性分析中，本文开发了一种机器学习反事实方法，用以还原创建于100年前的保护区在当下的影响。较新保护区的短期影响较小且统计上不显著，而较老保护区则产生了巨大收益。此前研究可能因仅估算新设保护区的短期效应而严重低估了保护区的效益。总体而言，本文估算保护区每年使家庭收入增加约3000亿兰特（约占2011年GDP的10%），这相当于南非保护区创造了约760万个就业等效岗位。不同类型的保护区在保护不同类别受威胁鸟类方面发挥着互补作用，彰显了南非整个保护区网络的价值。结构性旅行成本模型估算显示，南非国家公园每年为国内外游客产生77亿兰特（2023年兰特币值）的游憩价值。这些结果表明，在南非，野生动物保护与经济发展之间几乎不存在权衡取舍。然而，实现保护区的经济与生态效益需要耐心：保护的回报需要数十年而非数年才能积累显现。

title: Comment on “On the pass‐through rate of the Nutrition North Canada subsidy”
title_zh: 对“加拿大北方营养补贴传导率”一文的评论
title_primary: 对“加拿大北方营养补贴传导率”一文的评论
title_secondary: Comment on “On the pass‐through rate of the Nutrition North Canada subsidy”
authors: Tracey Galloway, Nicholas Li
official: 官方在线 2026-07-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Naylor, Deaton and Ker provide estimates of Nutrition North Canada subsidy pass‐through using data we collected and an identification strategy we devised. They propose an alternative econometric specification based on estimating passthrough for separate monopoly and non‐monopoly sub‐samples and aggregating the coefficients using subsidy share weights. They argue that this specification is more appropriate for estimating overall subsidy pass‐through and conclude that its application to our data provides evidence for full subsidy pass‐through. We show that their conclusions are not warranted by making two distinct but related points. First, we show that conclusions based on their specification are not robust to two changes in the estimating sample. Correcting two subsidy assignment and one monopoly classification error in the original data set, or using a time period more relevant for comparing heterogeneous effects across monopoly and non‐monopoly communities, leads to estimates that either reinforce our original finding of incomplete passthrough or that are too imprecise to be informative. Second, we provide a graphical illustration and power calculation to make a more general point about the appropriateness and limitations of the type of sub‐sample analysis they propose in settings with limited sample size and statistical power.
abstract_zh: Naylor、Deaton和Ker利用我们收集的数据及我们设计的识别策略，估算了“营养北方加拿大”补贴的传导效应。他们提出了一种替代性计量模型，基于对垄断与非垄断子样本分别估算传导效应，并通过补贴份额权重对系数进行加总。他们认为该模型更适合估算整体补贴传导效应，并据此得出结论：将该模型应用于我们的数据可证明补贴完全传导。我们通过两个独立但相关的论点表明，其结论缺乏依据。第一，我们证明其模型结论对估算样本的两项调整缺乏稳健性。修正原始数据集中的两项补贴分配错误和一项垄断分类错误，或采用更适用于比较垄断与非垄断社区异质性效应的时段，所得估算结果要么强化了我们最初关于不完全传导的发现，要么因精度过低而无法提供有效信息。第二，我们通过图形说明和统计功效计算，就其在样本量有限且统计功效不足的背景下所提出的子样本分析方法的适用性与局限性，提出更一般性的观点。

authors: HANFENG CHEN, MARIA ELENA FILIPPIN
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We analyze risks to bank intermediation following the introduction of a central bank digital currency (CBDC) competing with commercial bank deposits as households' source of liquidity. We revisit the equivalence of payment systems result, introducing a collateral constraint on banks' borrowing from the central bank. Comparing equilibria with and without CBDC, we find that the central bank can ensure the same equilibrium allocation by offering loans to banks. However, to access loans, banks must hold collateral at the expense of extending credit to firms. While CBDC introduction has no real effects, it changes aggregate capital ownership and banks' business models.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了央行数字货币（CBDC）引入后对银行中介业务的风险，该数字货币与商业银行存款作为家庭流动性来源形成竞争。我们重新审视了支付系统等价性结论，引入了银行从央行借款的抵押约束。通过比较引入CBDC与未引入CBDC的均衡状态，我们发现央行可以通过向银行提供贷款来确保相同的均衡配置。然而，为获得贷款，银行必须以牺牲向企业发放信贷为代价持有抵押品。尽管CBDC的引入没有实际影响，但它改变了总体资本所有权和银行的商业模式。

abstract: We compare how well agents aggregate information in two repeated social learning environments. In the first setting agents have access to a public data set. In the second they have access to the same data, and also to the past actions of others. Despite the fact that actions contain no additional payoff-relevant information, and despite potential herd behavior, free riding and information overload issues, observing and imitating the actions of others leads agents to take the optimal action more often in the second setting. We also investigate the effect of group size, as well as a setting in which agents observe private data and others’ actions.
abstract_zh: 我们比较了两种重复社会学习环境中主体聚合信息的能力。在第一种环境中，主体可访问公共数据集。在第二种环境中，他们可访问相同的数据，以及他人过去的行为。尽管行为不包含额外的与收益相关的信息，且存在潜在的羊群行为、搭便车和信息过载问题，观察并模仿他人的行为使得主体在第二种环境中更频繁地采取最优行动。我们还研究了群体规模的影响，以及一种主体观察私人数据与他人行为的环境。

title: Foundational processes and growth
title_zh: 基础过程与增长
title_primary: 基础过程与增长
title_secondary: Foundational processes and growth
authors: Wing Wah Tham, Salomé Baslandze, Elvira Sojli, Leo Liu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies the interaction between process and product innovations and their distinct role in firm growth dynamics. We differentiate empirically and theoretically two types of process innovations: foundational processes that advance production technology and cost-reducing processes that enhance existing production efficiency. We develop an innovation model of product varieties with quality heterogeneity to illustrate how these innovations impact firm growth differently and highlight how process innovation induces product innovation. By analyzing millions of patent texts from 1900 to 2020, we classify innovations into product, cost-reducing process, and foundational process innovations. We find that foundational processes lead to sustained firm growth, especially through their effect on subsequent product creation. R&D-intensive firms focused on “deep-tech” innovations have an advantage in creating foundational processes, resulting in superior product quality. Using patents linked to FDA-approved drugs, we show that firms with a comparative advantage in creating foundational processes, due to greater knowledge and technological stock, tend to produce higher-value products.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了过程创新与产品创新之间的相互作用及其在企业成长动态中的不同作用。我们在实证和理论上区分了两种类型的过程创新：推进生产技术的奠基性过程创新和提升现有生产效率的成本降低型过程创新。我们构建了一个具有质量异质性的产品种类创新模型，以阐明这些创新如何对企业成长产生不同影响，并突出过程创新如何诱发产品创新。通过分析1900年至2020年间数百万份专利文本，我们将创新分类为产品创新、成本降低型过程创新和奠基性过程创新。我们发现，奠基性过程创新能够带来持续的企业成长，尤其是通过其对后续产品创造的影响。专注于“深科技”创新的研发密集型企业，在创造奠基性过程创新方面具有优势，从而带来更优的产品质量。利用与FDA批准药物相关联的专利，我们表明，由于拥有更丰富的知识和技术储备，在创造奠基性过程创新方面具有比较优势的企业，往往能生产出更高价值的产品。

abstract: I propose a general theory of strategic network formation based on increasing marginal linking costs and vertical heterogeneity among the players. In the spirit of revealed preference, I describe the entire set of graphs that can be stable, without making any parametric assumptions about players’ preferences. Stable graphs feature assortativity and clustering, and I highlight conditions that lead to hierarchies and cliquish behavior. Extensions shed light on which findings are robust and which are more fragile. Collectively, these results map interpretable properties of preferences to particular network structures and furnish new tools to study strategic network formation.
abstract_zh: 我提出一个基于递增边际连接成本和参与者间垂直异质性的战略网络形成一般理论。遵循显示偏好的精神，我描述了所有可能稳定的图集，而不对参与者的偏好做任何参数假设。稳定图表现出同配性和聚类性，并强调了导致层级结构和派系行为的条件。扩展部分揭示了哪些发现是稳健的，哪些更为脆弱。总体而言，这些结果将偏好的可解释属性映射到特定网络结构，并为研究战略网络形成提供了新工具。

title: Managing Financial Crises
title_zh: 管理金融危机
title_primary: 管理金融危机
title_secondary: Managing Financial Crises
authors: Gianluca Benigno, Alessandro Rebucci, Aliaksandr Zaretski, Bruno Albuquerque, Eugenio Cerutti 等
official: 官方在线 2025-10-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In this paper, we revisit the question of how to manage financial crises using the framework proposed in Bianchi and Mendoza (2018). We show that this model economy exhibits a multiplicity of constrained-efficient equilibria, which arises because the private shadow value of collateral influences the forward-looking asset price. Among these equilibria, the specific one studied by Bianchi and Mendoza (2018) can be implemented using a tax/subsidy on debt alone. In that case, both the ex ante tax and ex post subsidy are quantitatively important for welfare under the optimal time-consistent policy. Limiting either component can lead to a welfare loss relative to the unregulated competitive equilibrium, highlighting the complementarity between crisis prevention and crisis resolution tools. We also show that, under certain conditions, all Pareto-dominant constrained-efficient equilibria entail the unconstrained allocation chosen by a social planner subject to the country budget constraint, and this allocation can be implemented with purely ex post policies.
abstract_zh: 本文利用Bianchi与Mendoza（2018）提出的分析框架，重新探讨了金融危机管理问题。研究表明，该模型经济中存在多重约束有效均衡，其根源在于抵押品的私人影子价值会影响前瞻性资产价格。在这些均衡中，Bianchi与Mendoza（2018）所研究的特定均衡可通过单一的债务税收/补贴政策实现。在此情形下，事前税收与事后补贴对于最优时间一致性政策下的福利水平均具有显著数量影响。若对任一政策工具施加限制，相较于无监管的竞争性均衡将导致福利损失，这凸显了危机预防工具与危机化解工具之间的互补性。此外，本文证明：在特定条件下，所有帕累托占优的约束有效均衡均等同于受国家预算约束的社会计划者所选择的非约束配置，且该配置可通过纯粹的事后政策实现。

title: Gene-Environment Complementarity in Educational Attainment

title_primary: 教育成就中的基因-环境互补性
title_secondary: Gene-Environment Complementarity in Educational Attainment
authors: Dilnoza Muslimova, Hans van Kippersluis, Cornelius A. Rietveld, Stephanie von Hinke, S. Fleur W. Meddens
official: 官方在线 2024-11-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Firstborns, on average, complete more education than laterborns. We study whether individuals’ endowments measured by genetic information amplify this effect. Our familyfixed effects approach allows exploiting exogenous variation in birth order and genetic endowments among 14,850 siblings in the UK Biobank. We find that those with higher genetic endowments benefit disproportionately more from being firstborn compared to those with lower endowments, providing a clean example of how nature and nurture interact in producing human capital. Since parental investments are a dominant channel driving birth order effects, our results are consistent with complementarity between endowments and investments in human capital formation.
abstract_zh: 平均而言，头胎子女比后生子女完成更多教育。我们研究以遗传信息衡量的个体禀赋是否会放大这一效应。通过采用家庭固定效应方法，我们利用英国生物银行中14,850名兄弟姐妹在出生顺序和遗传禀赋上的外生变异进行分析。研究发现，与低遗传禀赋者相比，高遗传禀赋者从作为头胎子女中获得的收益显著更大——这为先天禀赋与后天培养如何相互作用以形成人力资本提供了清晰例证。由于父母投资是驱动出生顺序效应的主导渠道，我们的结果与禀赋与人力资本形成投资之间的互补性假说一致。
